programme.desc: Com os primeiros hóspedes da época prestes a chegar, a piscina continua a ser um pesadelo para Mandy e Steve. À medida que tentam terminá-la a tempo, surgem tempestades e novos atrasos fazem com que pareça que nunca conseguirão deixar a mansão pronta a tempo.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Evite que a sua abundância de ervas frescas murche com as receitas da Mary para as utilizar num instante.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece as irmãs Boccanfuso que procuram um cachorrinho para tomar conta delas na escola. Visitam o West Highland terrier, o Wheaton terrier e o Airedale terrier, mas quando cada uma das irmãs gosta de um cão diferente, as coisas complicam-se.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece a família LaBarbera que procura um cão de grande porte para os seus quatro filhos. Visitam o pastor alemão, o husky siberiano e o braco alemão de pelo curto, mas será que o pai consegue encontrar o cachorrinho ideal para tomar conta da família?.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece a família Jensenque que está à procura de um companheiro para o cão da família, o Dexter. Visitam o linnois, o bernedoodle miniatura e o jarkie. Toda a gente tem o seu preferido, mas apenas um pode ser o novo amigo do Dexter.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A apenas oito semanas da abertura, o hotel Blok sofre um novo revés. Decisões familiares têm de ser tomadas.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Quando um desastre atinge as Bahamas, Bryan e Sarah têm de encontrar um novo lar para a família.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Bryan e Sarah continuam a trabalhar contra o relógio para terem a estância pronta a tempo.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Hoje, Dick está com Donna McDougal, que acredita que uma horda de armaduras antigas foi escondida no lago da sua mansão. Conseguirão localizar essa mítica horda?.

programme.title: Feito Para Durar T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Neste episódio, temos um desafio especial: criar um espaço de estudo confortável, bonito e inspirador para uma criança, sem comprar tudo novo.

programme.title: Feito Para Durar T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Quem tem cão conhece o cenário: taças no chão, saco de ração à vista e um canto funcional, mas pouco bonito. Neste episódio, queremos criar uma zona de refeição para o cão que seja prática, organizada e integrada na decoração da cozinha.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: As quatro cabanas de férias estão completamente transformadas e, para surpresa das equipas exaustas, ainda há um último desafio: o ancoradouro.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Scott e Bryan combinam trabalho o diversão, num paraíso para as quatro estações, ao darem início à segunda temporada de Renovation Resort.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Marlene Vieira mergulha nos sabores mais rústicos e reconfortantes da cozinha portuguesa, com duas receitas que evocam campo, família e comida feita com presença. A refeição começa com uma Sopa de Tomate, uma receita simples, com raízes no Ribatejo e no Alentejo, nascida da cozinha de aproveitamento e da valorização dos ingredientes da terra.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Marlene Vieira cruza duas geografias e duas formas de conforto à mesa: o Algarve dos pescadores e o Alentejo dos pratos cozinhados devagar. A entrada é um Atum de Escabeche, receita ligada aos antigos métodos de conservação e pela memória da cozinha de pescadores.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T3 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: John vai ao brunch em Palm Springs, Califórnia, com uma rabanada recheada de custarda e amora com a qual vale a pena estragar a dieta. John parte para o norte até à bela cidade de Quebeque, no Quebeque, para explorar os sabores da bela província com umas tenrinhas bochechas de bisonte estufadas.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T3 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: John parte para a soalheira San Diego, Califórnia, para um curso intensivo em cozinha chicana e prepara um burrito enorme recheado com ingrediente Mexi-Cali especial: batatas fritas! John viaja até à Costa Ocidental para desfrutar de um prato de peixe digno da lista de desejos: um risoto cremoso de cozedura lenta com vieiras fritas da Baía de Fundy.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Caldeirada de enguia” proposta pelo Mercado de S. Pedro de Figueira da Foz e, depois, irá cozinhar “Vitela assada no forno”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado de Alvalade de Lisboa.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Raia frita com legumes salteados” proposta pelo Mercado de Santana de Caldas da Rainha e, depois, irá cozinhar “Bolo intenso”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado Municipal de Nazaré.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Evite que a sua abundância de ervas frescas murche com as receitas da Mary para as utilizar num instante.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Celebrar a estação com as receitas da Mary que tiram partido de produtos de edição limitada, incluindo tomates, curgetes, pimentos e bagas.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Fátima vai à casa do amigo de longa data José Figueiras para cozinhar um empadão. Entre memórias, muitas gargalhadas e histórias partilhadas, falam sobre o que sustenta três décadas de televisão: afeto, resiliência e uma alegria de viver constante.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Fátima Lopes prepara bifes de peru panados com arroz de feijão, um prato cheio de memórias para Joana Cruz. Em cima da mesa, vários temas, incluindo a forma corajosa, bem-humorada e esperançosa com que Joana enfrentou o cancro.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Marlene Vieira mergulha nos sabores mais rústicos e reconfortantes da cozinha portuguesa, com duas receitas que evocam campo, família e comida feita com presença. A refeição começa com uma Sopa de Tomate, uma receita simples, com raízes no Ribatejo e no Alentejo, nascida da cozinha de aproveitamento e da valorização dos ingredientes da terra.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Marlene Vieira cruza duas geografias e duas formas de conforto à mesa: o Algarve dos pescadores e o Alentejo dos pratos cozinhados devagar. A entrada é um Atum de Escabeche, receita ligada aos antigos métodos de conservação e pela memória da cozinha de pescadores.

programme.title: Gordon Great Escape T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Gordon aventura-se fora dos percursos habituais rumo ao Camboja. Após os anos de domínio dos Khmer Vermelhos e da guerra civil, o país ficou praticamente reduzido ao ponto zero. Hoje, encontra-se em recuperação e a sua gastronomia vive um renascimento.

programme.title: Gordon Great Escape T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Gordon está na Malásia, onde rapidamente descobre que são as mulheres, e não os chefs, quem verdadeiramente domina as cozinhas. Ao longo da semana, aprende com algumas das melhores cozinheiras do país.

programme.title: Gordon Great Escape T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Gordon viaja até à Tailândia, berço de uma das gastronomias que mais tem conquistado os britânicos. Ainda antes de deixar Banguecoque, um dos mais conceituados chefs televisivos do país inscreve-o num duelo culinário que será transmitido no seu programa no final da semana.

programme.title: Passport Properties T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No calcanhar da bota italiana, Billy Nash explora Puglia e a península de Salento, onde a paixão pela herança e pelo artesanato define o quotidiano.

programme.title: Personaliza A Tua Casa T1 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: No trabalho dos artesãos mais criativos Sofia Pereira encontra a inspiração para em cada episódio nos mostrar 3 propostas decorativas. Neste episódio – Cortiça.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T4 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Com a conclusão da sua casa na Florida, Bryan e Sarah refletem sobre o que construíram e a sua experiência como proprietários de um hotel.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A família Baeumler muda-se para as Bahamas com a esperança de renovar e abrir uma estância à beira-mar.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Stephanie propõe-se restaurar a estufa original do castelo, recentemente danificada numa tempestade. Lee e Belinda continuam a expandir o seu novo espaço ao ar livre.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 40
programme.desc: Stephanie tem um mês para converter o antigo estábulo num estúdio para o lançamento dos seus fins de semana de arte. No entanto, a discordância com a mãe Isobel quanto ao design pode fazer com que as renovações demorem mais do que o previsto.

programme.desc: Travelogue is a 30-minute travel program. Through the journeys of our intrepid hosts, we experience the beauty, culture and mystery of China, discovering how people live in this vast country and showcasing Chinas transformation to the world.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: Bunker Game
programme.desc: Após vários acidentes misteriosos, um jogo de interpretação de papéis ao vivo é interrompido e os jogadores abandonam o local. Enquanto isso, o pessoal permanece para trás para investigar o desaparecimento do mentor do jogo.

programme.title: A Crueldade De Peter
programme.desc: No início do século XX, Peter, o filho de 13 anos de uma rica família inglesa, é cruel com as crianças, os animais e os criados. Uma noite, em retaliação pela sua crueldade, é emboscado, atirado para um caixão enterrado no cemitério e esquecido. Até que um século depois ele é reencontrado

programme.title: Toro
programme.desc: Dois irmãos reencontram-se ao fim de dois anos um deles tem estado preso, o outro roubou um perigoso recetador e agora estão ambos em fuga, juntamente com Diana, a filha menor do último, numa viagem pela Andaluzia violenta, mítica, agreste e selvagem.

programme.title: O Livro Das Soluções
programme.desc: Marc é um realizador de cinema que leva toda a sua equipa de produção para a pequena aldeia de Cévennes, onde a sua a criatividade gera milhões de ideias que o mergulham no caos total, o que o leva a escrever um guia de conselhos práticos, O Livro das Soluções

programme.title: Alvo Número 1
programme.desc: Em 1989, um jornalista canadiano investiga as circunstâncias em torno do encarceramento altamente suspeito de um viciado em heroína numa prisão tailandesa.

programme.title: O Filho
programme.desc: A vida atribulada de Peter, da sua nova companheira Beth e do bebé do casal vai tornar-se ainda mais complicada quando vai viver lá para casa o problemático filho de 17 anos que ele teve com a ex-mulher, para o qual gostaria de ser o pai atento e cuidador que ele próprio nunca teve.

programme.title: O Pai Tirano
programme.desc: Chico ama Tatão, que é cortejada por Artur. Por seu turno, Graça ama Chico mas não sabe que ele ama Tatão. Santana escreve uma peça para os Grandelinhas que servirá de guião à paixão de Chico e convencerá Tatão de que ele é um rico conde. Mas nada vai acontecer como previsto.

programme.title: Réplicas
programme.desc: William Foster é um neurocientista genial cuja mulher e os três filhos morrem num acidente de carro. Secretamente, ele vai tentar clonar os seus corpos criando réplicas, mas vai ter de fazer uma escolha radical ele só consegue trazer três dos seus quatro familiares de volta à vida.

programme.title: A Morte Fica-vos Tão Bem
programme.desc: Há 14 anos, Madeline seduziu Ernest, que estava noivo de Helen, e casou com ele. Agora ele está alcoólico e deprimido e junta-se à antiga namorada para matar Madeline. Só que ela tomou um elixir da juventude que lhe dá vida eterna, por isso matá-la não será suficiente.

programme.title: O Informador
programme.desc: Peter Koslow é um ex-soldado das Operações Especiais que é recrutado pelo FBI para se tornar informador e derrubar o maior senhor do crime de Nova Iorque. Quando a operação corre mal, ele fica preso entre a máfia, a polícia e o FBI e terá de escapar para salvar a sua família.

Quando uma arma ultrassecreta cai em mãos erradas, a agente da CIA Mason Mace Brown terá de unir forças com a sua rival Marie, com a antiga aliada do MI6 Khadijah e ainda com a hábil psicóloga colombiana Graciela, numa perigosa missão na qual terão de enfrentar a misteriosa Lin Mi Sheng.

programme.title: O Cobrador 2
programme.desc: French e Sue voltam a formar uma dupla de cobradores de dívidas, desta vez com a missão de ir a Las Vegas recuperar o dinheiro da proprietária de um casino, que afinal já foi amante de um deles, ao mesmo tempo que tentam sobreviver ao mafioso que os mandou matar para vingar a morte do irmão.

programme.title: Homefront - A Última Defesa
programme.desc: Um ex-agente do departamento de combate à droga muda-se com a filha para uma pequena cidade rural em busca de uma vida tranquila. Quando um conflito escolar expõe o seu passado, ele atrai a atenção de um perigoso traficante local que ameaça a sua família.

programme.title: A Vigilante
programme.desc: Sadie é uma mulher que foi abusada pelo marido e que dedica a vida a salvar outras vítimas de violência doméstica, ao mesmo tempo que tenta matar o seu agressor para se tornar verdadeiramente livre.

programme.title: O Enigma Da Rosa
programme.desc: Uma família vê a filha mais nova ser raptada a caminho da escola e recebe uma carta do raptor a pedir um encontro antes de libertá-la. Para surpresa de todos, em vez de dinheiro, o raptor quer a confissão do segredo de um dos membros da família.

programme.title: Rapazes Nas Árvores
programme.desc: Na noite de Halloween de 1997, Corey, Jango e o restante grupo de skaters despedem-se do liceu, mas o primeiro reencontra Jonah, seu amigo da escola primária, vítima de crueldade por parte do segundo, e o percurso de ambos de regresso a casa torna-se cada vez mais estranho e assustador.

programme.title: Um Mercado De Milhões
programme.desc: O futebol dos nossos dias é uma indústria global onde estão em jogo milhares de milhões de euros. Driss Berzane é um agente de jogadores à beira da falência, que tem apenas sete dias até ao encerramento do mercado de transferências para conseguir pagar uma dívida de 300 mil euros.

programme.title: Call Jane Tu Não Estás Só
programme.desc: Na Chicago dos anos 60, uma mulher casada e feliz vê sua vida virada do avesso quando tem uma gravidez que coloca um sério risco à sua própria vida. Sem hipótese de a interromper de forma legal, ela acaba por entrar em contacto com um grupo de mulheres que lhe oferece ajuda, as Jane.

programme.title: A Morte Fica-vos Tão Bem
programme.desc: Há 14 anos, Madeline seduziu Ernest, que estava noivo de Helen, e casou com ele. Agora ele está alcoólico e deprimido e junta-se à antiga namorada para matar Madeline. Só que ela tomou um elixir da juventude que lhe dá vida eterna, por isso matá-la não será suficiente.

programme.title: Preto Ou Branco
programme.desc: Elliott Anderson, recentemente viúvo, fica responsável por cuidar da neta mas é levado a tribunal pela avó paterna, que quer obter a custódia da criança, obrigando as duas famílias a confrontarem-se com os medos e convicções mais profundos no que respeita a raça, perdão e compreensão.

programme.title: Cosmoball - Os Jogadores Da Galáxia
programme.desc: Uma enorme nave espacial ergue-se acima da Terra é uma espécie de estádio para um jogo vagamente parecido com o futebol moderno, mas a velocidades incrivelmente altas. Este é um jogo de bola espacial e quando o jogo começa, o mundo pára para ver.

programme.title: Tango E Cash
programme.desc: Dois polícias de Los Angeles, o aprumado Ray Tango e o desalinhado Gabriel Cash, caem numa cilada do seu implacável arqui-inimigo e são colocados atrás das grades. Agora, vão ter de deixar para trás as suas diferenças e trabalharem juntos para poderem sobreviver e provar a sua inocência.

programme.title: First Kill Caça Ao Homem
programme.desc: Will Beeman é um bem sucedido profissional de Wall Street cujo filho é raptado. Para resgatar o rapaz, ele terá ajudar o raptor a recuperar a chave que dá acesso ao dinheiro roubado num banco, sempre perseguido pelo chefe da polícia Marvin Howell.

programme.title: Fortaleza
programme.desc: Robert vive numa espécie de estância natural criada para oficiais reformados dos serviços secretos dos EUA. Quando um grupo de criminosos invade o complexo com intenções de o matar, ele vai ter de encontrar um modo de proteger as vidas de todos os que lá se encontram.

programme.title: Dartagnan, O 4 Mosqueteiro
programme.desc: A pedido do seu pai, o jovem DArtagnan viaja da Gasconha rural para Paris para se tornar mosqueteiro e acaba envolvido numa conspiração do traidor Conde Rochefort contra o Rei Luís XIV, juntando-se aos três célebres mosqueteiros para deter os inimigos da coroa.

programme.title: Hotel Mumbai
programme.desc: Esta é a história do ataque terrorista ao luxuoso Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, em Bombaim, no ano de 2008. No meio do caos, os funcionários do hotel arriscam a vida para manterem todos a salvo e fazem sacrifícios impensáveis para se protegerem a si e às suas famílias.

programme.title: The Contractor Mercenário
programme.desc: Após ser dispensado das Forças Especiais do Exército e perder a pensão e o seguro de saúde, James Harper, endividado e com a família para sustentar, assina contrato com a uma equipa militar privada. Só que quando primeira missão corre mal, ele torna-se um alvo a abater.

programme.title: Hardcore
programme.desc: Henry é ressuscitado da morte sem memória do seu passado e tem de salvar a sua mulher de um senhor da guerra com poderes de telecinesia, um exército de mercenários e um plano para dominar o mundo.

programme.title: Mahler - The Song of Lamentation
programme.desc: Mexican conductor José Areán leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería and four vocal soloists in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s cantata ‘The Song of Lamentation’ (Das klagende Lied). Among the soloists are soprano Sally Dibblee, mezzo-soprano Marjorie Elinor Dix, tenor Arturo Chacón, and bass Stephen West.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s tragic opera Rigoletto (1851). In 1850, Teatro La Fenice commissioned Verdi to compose a new opera. Verdi proposed Victor Hugo’s controversial play Le Roi s'amuse to his librettist Francesco Maria Piave.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 45 'Farewell'
programme.desc: Under the direction of Conrad van Alphen, the Sinfonia Rotterdam Orchestra performs Haydn's Symphony No. 45 at the Nieuwe Kerk (New Church) in The Hague. This piece is nicknamed 'Farewell' because of a funny anecdote. Haydn and his musicians stayed every year from May to October at the magnificent Esterháazy Palace, at the request of Prince Nicholas.

programme.title: J. S. Bach: Mass in B minor, BWV 232
programme.desc: In this concert, Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhaus Orchestra and Kammerchor for the last time as the Gewandhaus Music Director at the Leipzig Bachfest 2005. After seven successful years in Leipzig, the maestro performs J. S. Bach's Mass in B minor (BWV 232), one of the greatest works of church music ever written. Soloists are Ruth Ziesak (soprano), Anna Larsson (alto), Christoph Genz (tenor), and Dietrich Henschel (bass).

programme.title: Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace I
programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads his Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), I’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and tar, a traditional plucked string instrument of Persian music, played here by Saeed Mirzazadeh. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in 1986 at the initiative of Claudio Abbado and has since become the world’s best youth orchestra. Named after the great composer, the programme is marked by the special relationship between the maestro and the young orchestra, as well as their special relationship to Gustav Mahler.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 22
programme.desc: Pianist Mikhail Pletnev is accompanied by the Russian National Orchestra led by Kirill Karabits in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 22. At its premiere in 1868, the orchestra was led by Anton Rubinstein, with the composer himself at the piano. The current concert was recorded at the Moscow Philharmonic Society and opens with a performance of Sergei Prokofiev's symphonic picture 'Dreams'.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le sacre du printemps
programme.desc: Maestro Bernard Haitink leads the Berliner Philharmoniker in a performance of Igor Stravinsky's Le sacre du printemps (‘The Rite of Spring’). Stravinksy composed the ballet’s score in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's itinerant ballet company Ballets Russes. The work’s sensational première at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées in Paris caused a riot in the audience in response to the avant-garde nature of the music and choreography.

programme.title: First Snow
programme.desc: One of the first Christmas carols ever written is Perotin the Great’s Salvatoris Hodie. This brilliant 12th century composition, one of the first works ever written for four voices, opens First Snow: the atmospheric Christmas concert by the Brussels Philharmonic.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 94, Hob. I:94
programme.desc: Joseph Haydn (1732-1809): Symphony No. 94 in G major 'Surprise'. Berliner Philharmoniker; conductor: Mariss Jansons. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991. The musicians commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra's founding on May 1st, 1882, playing in different European cities. This concert was recorded in the church 'Hagia Eirene' in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala – Awards Night
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history.

programme.title: Galaxymphony Strikes Back
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Chamber music
programme.desc: Philippe Herreweghe conducts his Collegium Vocale Gent in this chamber music program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. On the program are Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; Gott der Herr ist Sonn und Schild, BWV 79; and Missa brevis in G major, BWV 236. The soloists are soprano Dorothee Mields, tenor Thomas Hobbs, countertenor Alex Potter, and bass Peter Kooij.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Wolf, De Falla, Poulenc a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Sophia Burgos (USA, 1991) and pianist Daniel Gerzenberg (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Ich esse nun mein Brod nicht trocken mehr’, ‘Wer rief dich den?’, ‘Schweig’ einmal still, du garst’ger Schwätzer dort!

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Elias Ackerley
programme.desc: Pianist Elias Ackerley (United Kingdom/South Korea, 2001) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro molto moderato, of Gabriel Fauré’s Piano Quartet No. 1 in C minor, Op. 15.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 14, KV 449
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 4, Op. 18, No. 4
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Brahms - Double Concerto in A minor, Op. 102
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven And Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: Confusing as it may be: Ludwig van Beethoven’s Second Piano Concerto was in fact composed ten years prior to his First Piano Concerto. The cause of this mess lies with the composer himself: Beethoven held back the publication of what we know as the Second Piano Concerto until after that of the First Piano Concerto, so he could thoroughly review the piece.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Stravinsky, Webern and Debussy
programme.desc: Today’s Brussels Philharmonic concert focuses on the diverse musical styles that characterized the first half of the 20th century. In addition to the impressionism of Claude Debussy's Jeux (1913), conductor Michel Tabachnik's ensemble focuses on one of the leading composers of modern music: Igor Stravinsky. His first ballet music, Firebird (1910), is a highlight of the concert.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century.

programme.title: Ravel - Piano Concerto for the left hand And Boléro
programme.desc: Péter Csaba leads the Spanish Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet del Encuentro in this inaugural concert of the Encuentro de Música y Academia de Santander. The program opens with Ravel’s Piano Concerto for the left hand in D major, featuring Uzbekistani-born American pianist Stanislav Ioudenitch as the soloist.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky – Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Mozart - Così fan tutte
programme.desc: Maestro Zubin Mehta leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s comic opera Così fan tutte (1790). Following the successful operas Le nozze di Figaro (1786) and Don Giovanni (1787), Così fan tutte was the third and last collaboration between Mozart and the Venetian librettist and poet Lorenzo Da Ponte.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.desc: “Minha Terra, Minha Gente” apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. programme.title: Feira Semanal: Nazaré
programme.desc: Na Nazaré, a feira mistura-se com o vento, sal e com o som do mar. É uma extensão da vida piscatória, mas também uma celebração da terra e da fé. Aqui a feira não é só comércio — é mar e monte, fé e sustento, é história a acontecer à sombra dos toldos e ao som do pregão. Aqui, tudo tem cor: os sapatos as vozes, as saias das mulheres que vendem com orgulho e graça. As vozes são firmes, as saias são sete.

programme.title: A Letra: Paulo Gonzo - 'Jardins Proibidos'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas nas canções. A canção “Jardins Proibidos” foi lançada em 1992 no álbum Pedras da Calçada, o primeiro disco do artista inteiramente cantado em português. A canção, com música de Paulo Gonzo e Luís Oliveira e letra de Paulo Gonzo e Pedro Malaquias, tornou-se rapidamente um dos maiores êxitos da música portuguesa.

programme.title: Documentário: Raiz De Bruma
programme.desc: 'Raiz de Bruma' refere-se principalmente ao documentário histórico 'Raiz de Bruma - Cerveira, 700 anos a fazer história', que narra as origens e a evolução de Vila Nova de Cerveira, Portugal, destacando testemunhos, monumentos e tradições locais. O filme celebra os 700 anos da carta do foral atribuída pelo Rei D. Dinis, explorando mitos e a cultura local. .

programme.title: A Letra: Ana Bacalhau - Imperial É Fino

Foi mais facil falar desta letra da Capicua, do que das suas, e assim se safou, entusiasmando-nos com este desafio.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: A oficina prepara-se para a feira SEMA 2022 em Las Vegas. Dave e Kev participam no primeiro concurso de elegância e os seus conhecimentos sobre automóveis são levados ao limite.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: A oficina está a fervilhar de atividade e o mais recente CF1 representa um novo desafio para a equipa, uma vez que Dave faz modificações ao original.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 56
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 56
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 113
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Live in France: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: Jimmy Smith: Live in '69 boasts an incredible 90-minute concert from 1969 filmed in Paris. Working in his classic trio format with longtime guitarist Eddie McFadden and drummer Charlie Crosby, Jimmy shows why he is still the uncontested king of the jazz organ.

programme.title: Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination.

programme.title: Piano and Sax: Charlie Mariano And Wolfgang Dauner
programme.desc: Piano and saxophone - this is an individualistic jazz duo combination. But the melodiousness and maturity of Charlie Mariano's saxophone and the freshness and feistiness of Wolfgang Dauner's piano turn the meeting of these two jazz greats into a thrilling interplay.

programme.title: Mr. Phone Bone
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: John Lurie: A Lounge Lizard Alone
programme.desc: In 1978, John Lurie formed The Lounge Lizards jazz ensemble with his brother Evan; the pair played music together for 20 years. However, in this New Year's Eve performance, Lurie (saxophone) plays a legendary show with drummer Larry Wright. Lurie is a musician, actor, painter, and the driving force behind the Strange And Beautiful music label.

programme.title: Give It to Him
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: You Don't Know What Love Is
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless.

programme.title: Song for my father
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax’ took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: Four Pianists - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Duke Ellington live at the Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: Duke Ellington: Live in '58 features the earliest-known filmed full-length concert by one of the 20th Century's greatest songwriters and bandleaders. Filmed at Amsterdam's famed Concertgebouw, this 80-minute concert features the 16-piece Duke Ellington Orchestra two years after their stunning performance at the 1956 Newport Jazz Festival, which Duke considered his second birth.

programme.title: La nuit des gitans
programme.desc: The Royal Conservatoire of Liège hosted a ‘Night of the Gypsies’ at the International Guitar Festival of Liège in 1995. At this occasion, the Raphaël Faÿs Trio and Quintet paid tribute to Romani-Belgian jazz guitarist Django Reinhardt.

programme.title: Django Memories
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty’, pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Carlinhos Brown
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Flying Home
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, American singer Ella Fitzgerald gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Solo Piano Summit
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a 'Solo Piano Summit,' audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The 'Solo Piano Summit' brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson.

programme.title: Chick Corea Elektric Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Münchner Klaviersommer: Eliane Elias Trio
programme.desc: There’s no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil’, seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards’, and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards’ in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Nubiyan Twist - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival.

programme.title: Ramón Valle And Reinier Baas - Music Meeting 2020
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. Disrupted by COVID-19, the festival’s 2020 edition had to adapt to new challenges.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, DPW
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Here's that rainy day
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: Moondog And The London Saxophonique
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century.?Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T.

programme.title: Bixiga 70 - BIRD 2019
programme.desc: Stemming from Brazil's São Paulo, Bixiga 70 is an exciting brass and percussion-based instrumental dance ensemble that combines jazz, funk, and Afro-Brazilian music, incorporating elements from dub, reggae, electronics, cumbia, carimbo, Ethio-jazz, and samba. The name Bixiga 70 is taken from a vibrant neighbourhood in downtown São Paulo.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Eli Paperboy Reed
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: Portrait: Torino Jazz Festival
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Christian Scott - The Centennial Trilogy
programme.desc: In just a few years, young trumpet player Christian Scott has become synonymous with a new jazz generation. He shakes up the conventions of jazz by taking the genre to new horizons and reaching a wider audience. No doubt, at 33 years old, Christian Scott is already forging his own path. After each record release, he seems even more determined to challenge the rules of jazz with his own avant-garde style.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Badbadnotgood
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: I Own the Night
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: Misc: Jérôme Beaulieu live in Montreal
programme.desc: Modern jazz with a twist, based on a group effort rather than on personal virtuosity: meet Misc! Composer and pianist Jérôme Beaulieu, double bassist Philippe Leduc and drummer William Côté met during their college years at the Université de Montréal. Their Trio Jérôme Beaulieu quickly made a name for itself, winning the Montreal contest Jazz en Rafale and the Grand Prix du Festi-Jazz in Rimouski within the same year.

programme.title: Panorama do Choro - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Panorama de Coro. This ensemble combines jazz and traditional Brazilian music.

programme.title: Jazz in Comblain-la-Tour, 1963
programme.desc: In 1963, the small Belgian town of Comblain-la-Tour hosted an exciting line-up of both new and older jazz groups. Opening things up is the British trombonist Charlie Galbraith’s All Star Jazz Band, performing classic Dixieland jazz. Next up is German singer Knut Kiesewetter, who, with backing from the Prague Dixieland Band, sings the blues.

programme.title: Michael Brecker Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel - Bandit 65
programme.desc: Jazzfest Bonn is an annual festival of modern and creative jazz music. Every May it presents local and international jazz musicians in concert halls all over the German city. Among the artists of the 2017 edition is Bandit 65, a trio of breathtaking virtuosity, great power, boundless breadth, and astounding beauty.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: Josh Evans - Pier One Import
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Bill Laurance Project
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves’ outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington’s career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features a welterweight bout between former champion Paul 'The Punisher' Williams (39-2, 27 KOs) and up and comer Erislandy Lara, aka 'The American Dream', 15-0, 10 KOs).

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: This episode features a Light Welterweight title bout between the unbeaten Danny Garcia and #1 contender Amir Khan, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is an interim WBA light welterweight title fight between Erik Morales and Marcos Maidana that gave Maidana a chance to leap back into the boxing title scene, while Morales provided fans with a vintage performance. Also on the card, action from WBO welterweight champ Carlos Quintanta.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T33 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 1 from Tokyo, Japan at the Ryogoku Kokugikan, features Mitakeumi, Takakeisho, Wakatakakage and Takanosho.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 52
programme.desc: This episode features a middleweight battle between Dmitry Priog and Daniel Jacobs that ends in a crushing overhand right, as well as kickboxing, sumo, weapons and more!.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Abu Dhabi Grand Slam on world Judo day, we speak to double world champion Mayra Aguiar about the unity of the Brazilian judo team, and watch as two world champions battle for gold in the -57kg division.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA T1 - Ep. 121
programme.desc: This episode features coverage of mixed martial arts headlined by an incredible middleweight fight that ends with a tapout between Dricus Du Plessis and Rafal Haratyk. Bonus coverage includes a middleweight melee that ends in submission between Mark Hulme and Gordon Roodman and a female strawweight fight that goes the distance between Danella Eliasov and Irene Rivera.

programme.title: WCCB: Uisma Lima vs. Shervantaigh Koopman T2025 - Ep. 531
programme.desc: The IBO Super Welterweight World Championship is on the line when champion Uisma Lima of Portugal defends against undefeated Shervantaigh Koopman at the Emperors Palace in Kempton Park, South Africa. Lima claimed the title with a unanimous decision victory over Sukhdeep Singh Bhatti in December, and will be looking to make his first successful defense against the IBO Intercontinental titleholder, Koopman.

programme.title: XMA T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: In this episode we follow one of our martial artists as he goes through a grueling tournament and how he uses technology to help him prepare for it.

programme.title: World Karate Federation T2023 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: The highest level of competition in the sport of karate anywhere in the world will take place from Budapest, Hungary, as the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS take place. The top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, will all converge on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world. Don't miss the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, only on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is then-undefeated Adrien Broner facing Martin Rodriguez for the vacant WBO super featherweight title. Also on the card, action from former welterweight champions Paul Williams and Kermit Cintron.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T33 - Ep. 2

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts T9 - Ep. 1

programme.title: MMA:30 T1 - Ep. 7
